It was clearly intended as a state flag meaning:

Plain text

const geometry = extractMapGeometry(grid) const segments = geometry.boundarySegments

TypeScript
if (segments.length === 0) { buildAwaitingBoundary() return }

Therefore the variable is just dead state left over from the implementation.

So what should we do?

Remove it.

Not because we are removing the SLAM functionality, but because we're removing a variable that currently has zero effect on the program.

The actual important LIVE functionality remains untouched:

  • segments.length === 0 awaiting state ✅
  • live holographic boundary mesh ✅
  • rail geometry ✅
